description: The floating surfaces fit their content and close themselves: the panel and the HUD resize to what they drew, and every surface hides itself — the panel after a switch, the HUD on its dwell, the sheets on Esc. hide and set-size are the window permissions beyond the default set; measured live, without allow-hide the panel stayed up after every switch and the HUD's dwell never hid it — the person read that as «висит вечно».
